# Narrative Detection & Profiling Pipeline - dependencies

# torch note: this project runs CPU-only locally. The pinned build below (`+cpu`) comes from
# PyTorch's dedicated CPU wheel index, NOT the default PyPI index:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
# If you have a CUDA-capable GPU, first install a matching CUDA build of torch yourself
# (see https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/), then run
# `pip install -r requirements.txt --no-deps torch` skipped (comment out the torch line below).
